_comment: Routes deal_finder.py scans on seats.aero. Destinations seeded from every route your old seats.aero alerts fired on, plus major long-haul gateways. Edit freely.
_watchlist_help: Watchlist entries are always reported when they clear their bar, even outside the top list. Fields: label, dests (required), origins, cabins (ECONOMY/PREMIUM_ECONOMY/BUSINESS/FIRST), start/end (YYYY-MM-DD), bar (CPP; omit for the cabin's usual 1.5/2.0). Example: {"label": "Japan cherry blossoms", "dests": ["NRT", "HND"], "cabins": ["BUSINESS"], "start": "2027-03-20", "end": "2027-04-10", "bar": 1.8}
